attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (CentOS Stream 10) as systemd services on static bootstrap config, opened firewalld ports 2379/2380. Verified cross-node read-after-write consistency, verified the cluster kept serving reads/writes with node3 stopped (2/3 quorum) and that node3 caught up fully after rejoining. Completed the mandatory sequential-restart evidence protocol on all three nodes: captured baseline boot_id/service/data state, rebooted each node one at a time via 'sudo reboot', confirmed each reboot acknowledgement returned before disconnect, polled until reachable again, confirmed each node's boot_id changed, and confirmed etcd rejoined with full 3/3 health and matching raft applied index, with prior keys still present, before proceeding to the next node.
